candidates.title: Ship-killer, missile shield, air-to-air weapon: Why SM-6 is America's 'three-in-one' missile
candidates.excerpt: The US Navy collaborated with the UK's Royal Navy and Air Force to sink the frigate Klakring. This exercise tested munitions such as the SM-6 missile and improved interoperability between the forces. Data collected from the Klakring will contribute to future weapon designs and strategies. The exercise featured various naval and aerial assets, enhancing operational readiness. Notable developments included the SM-6's adaptation as a versatile weapon system for multiple roles.

candidates.title: Former Maoist leaders seek revocation of death sentence in Jeeram Ghati case
candidates.excerpt: Former Maoist leaders have urged the Chhattisgarh High Court and Central and State governments to revoke the death sentences imposed on 10 adivasis in the Jeeram Ghati case. They also sought the release of Maoist and political prisoners.

candidates.title: Trump says China arms sale not discussed with Xi
candidates.excerpt: US President Donald Trump said that he had not discussed selling US military equipment to China during his meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, responding to an account attributed to his ambassador by a reporter at the White House.
